Create a full-length photorealistic heritage-fashion editorial: a rain-damp Peranakan-townhouse heritage-fashion scene built around a kebaya silhouette at blue hour. The subject is the same adult woman shown in the supplied portrait reference. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. She wears a fitted, front-opening kebaya blouse of fine embroidered voile over an opaque inner layer, fastened at the center with a three-piece brooch chain; its scalloped hem lies over a wrapped batik sarong. A sudden cross-breeze pushes one carved shutter open, and she catches its brass handle while an archival textile swatch slips halfway from a folio. Show the blouse opening, brooch linkage, waist-to-sarong boundary, wrapped lower silhouette, and embroidery together as readable garment evidence. Use controlled full-body framing, natural skin texture, humid reflections, and directional window light.
